verdict.rationale: Fenwick's IP practice page lists "new business models around open source software" as a named area of counsel, and its large technology transactions team describes itself as an IP counseling and licensing practice. That shows OSS-adjacent counsel, but the evidence never names open-source license compliance or OSS usage policies for product companies. Missing for 10: explicit named capability for OSS license compliance, OSS usage/governance policy drafting, any detail on compliance audits or license-obligation reviews, independent corroboration.
